profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer specializing in back end processes.  Enjoys working with databases using SQL.   Have worked with many OSes and environments and with a few good languages over the years.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)
positions.description:
- Using Go, added features and bug fixes for CAVA's digital ordering platform, delivering REST endpoints end-to-end — handler, service, and data layers plus OpenAPI contracts — across restaurant/store management, menu, CRM, and ordering domains built on a domain-driven architecture with Temporal workflows.
- Leveraged AI agentic development workflows (Claude Code) to accelerate delivery — automating code review, multi-step implementation, and test generation while maintaining code quality and API-contract accuracy.

positions.title: Product Engineer
positions.locationName: St. Petersburg, Florida, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Engineered, developed, and deployed a full-stack web application featuring a Nuxt.js (TypeScript) frontend and a Golang backend, this reporting service integrated Looker Embed capabilities, including features in the management of users, groups, platforms, and mapping of third-party identifiers.

Streamlined data ingestion by centralizing third-party reporting data into BigQuery via daily ETL processes developed in Golang, 
- Automated ETL development resulted in an estimated annual cost savings of $20,000 by eliminating third-party software dependency.

Automated cross-departmental manual processes:
- Created a Golang application leveraging the Wrike API to automate the transfer and archival of digital assets into Google Drive.
- Implemented a weekly process to transform Google Spreadsheet data into JSON format and securely store it in an AWS S3 bucket for downstream consumption.

Developed a POC utilizing GoHighLevel AI chatbot tools to create a lead reactivation sequence for qualifying historical leads.
- Designed and built an API in Golang integrated with GCP Firebase to enable OAuth and SAML authentication capabilities for the existing platform.

Served as a technology mentor for summer interns, overseeing product development initiatives through weekly progress updates and dedicated technical breakout sessions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Spearheaded the transition from legacy Ruby on Rails architecture to modern, RESTful API applications, primarily utilizing Golang for development.

Developed high-reliability gRPC services in Golang to interface with the existing Ruby on Rails application, ensuring robust and efficient data delivery.

Managed end-to-end deployment infrastructure using Kubernetes, leveraging Helm for package management and ArgoCD for continuous deployment pipelines.

positions.title: Computer Engineering; Contractor
positions.description:
Optum Healthcare
Upgrade and transition C application to Golang using best practices for testing and development patterns.
Feature enhancements for processing EDI x12 file formats using PHP

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered and deployed a critical high-risk payment processing module using Golang and React, enabling integrated third-party payment gateway interfacing.

This development secured a percentage of transaction revenue for the platform through optimized fee collection mechanisms.

Led the migration effort to transition monolithic PHP code into a modern, maintainable RESTful microservice architecture.

Managed and executed server deployments within the Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud environment.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer/System Architect
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and maintained a high-impact Single Page Application (SPA) from inception, utilizing React for the frontend and Go for the supporting API.

The successful deployment of this application generated an additional $200K in annual revenue.

Developed ancillary supporting services in Golang, including integrations with various third-party platforms.

Managed server infrastructure and deployments utilizing Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Directed talent development through the full cycle of interviewing, hiring, and training new technical team members.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and maintained the core advertising platform tagging infrastructure using JavaScript and Ruby, configuring the environment against Nginx servers.

Led the modernization of the Ruby on Rails platform by refactoring code into a RESTful microservice architecture using Golang, resulting in measurable savings in server operational and developer maintenance costs.

Managed software deployment utilizing Docker containers orchestrated within the AWS environment.

Executed a POC focused on user timeline data storage, developing the service in Ruby and configuring the infrastructure using Cassandra NoSQL deployed on AWS.

Served as the Team Lead for a five-person software development team, responsible for technical guidance, project oversight, and training incoming developers on both the marketing business context and the technical stack.

positions.title: Programmer III
positions.description:
Designed and developed:
- Web intranet applications in ASP.NET and ASP.MVC utilizing SQL Server 2005 and the Entity Framework.
- In-house, utility applications and libraries using C# and the 4.0.Net framework.

Interim team lead of 4 developers; mentoring, scheduling and product road mapping

Analysis of business processes for in-house groups in developing application solutions to satisfy internal auditing and government compliance.

Analysis of existing mortgage servicing system in implementing changes to accommodate HAMP legislation from the federal government.

DBA functions include changing schema, Stored Procedures and DTS utilizing SQL Server 2000/2005

positions.title: DBA - Contractor
positions.description:
Analysis of existing mortgage servicing system in implementing changes to accommodate HAMP legislation from the federal government.

DBA functions include changing schema, Stored Procedures and DTS utilizing SQL Server 2000 and 2005

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
Design and implementation of:
- MS SQL Server 2005 as data storage for custom applications utilizing ADO.Net 2.0.
- iPhone applications utilizing Objective-C and the iPhone SDK.
- Company's website utilizing ASP.Net with C# 3.5 and SQL Server 2005.
- Construction contract application for Harvey-Jenkins Homes Inc. utilizing Borland Delphi.
- Construction contract application tracked custom changes during the construction of various homes saving the company over $10,000 annually.
- Color sheet application for Harvey-Jenkins Homes Inc. utilizing Borland Delphi.

Application design and development in .Net environment utilizing Microsoft Visual Studio 2005 and C#.

Gathering and implementing client specifications to produce applications and reports.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: i.TV iPhone app: using objective-C and the iPhone SDK for development, brought on board to help a small team of developers complete this project for a client.  Client development done on MacOS.

positions.title: DBA
positions.description:
Optimization of daily cube analysis processes which saved ~10% of the processing time each day.

MSSQL 2000 administration (backups, monitoring, jobs, DTS, stored procedures, etc).

Designed and coded a weekly, manual task into an automated DTS process.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Public safety software, utilizing MFC C++, xml/xsl and perl, performing maintenance and new development for the Mobile product line.

Client/server development done on Windows and Unix.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Accounting Payable outsourcing processing for contracted clients.

MSSQL 2000 development and maintenance (monitoring, job, DTS, stored procedures, profiling, etc).  

Client development done on Windows with Delphi for in-house scanning & data-entry processes.  

Analysis and implementation of client business rules for data and transformation of data into the AP processes provided for the client.

Windows services development with Delphi.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
C maintenance development for McLeod trucking software utilizing Informix database.

Borland C++ client development of in-house support software for the Service Parts and Accident departments utilizing MySQL database.
